The task was to identify one bus stop nearest to the intersection of Main Street and Amherst Street in Altavista.

The result response names **“Amherst and 7th”** as the nearest bus stop and provides supporting distance information: a **410-foot / 2-minute walk** from the intersection labeled on Google Maps as **Amherst Ave & Main St**. The screenshot supports this by showing Google Maps walking directions from **Amherst Ave & Main St** to **Amherst and 7th**, with the route distance shown as approximately **410 ft**.

The response also mentions a comparison to another nearby stop, “Main Street Middle,” at 420 feet, supporting the claim that “Amherst and 7th” is the nearer of the identified bus stops.

Verdict: **SUCCESS**
